entries.rq04Evidence: RQ-04: the active Pages dashboard guard renders the noindex sign-in shell and links to the server-side Google sign-in entry.
entries.retirementCondition: Retire when the dashboard authentication entry is replaced and its privacy, callback, and recovery contract has an approved successor.

entries.rq04Evidence: RQ-04: the active Pages dashboard guard renders loading-independent configuration, unauthorized, and unavailable private states.
entries.retirementCondition: Retire when every protected dashboard failure state has an approved replacement that preserves noindex, no-store, and recovery behavior.

entries.rq04Evidence: RQ-04: the active authenticated Pages guard emits the React dashboard root, runtime configuration, noindex metadata, and dashboard assets.
entries.retirementCondition: Retire when the authenticated dashboard entry has a reviewed successor with equivalent runtime configuration and private response guarantees.

entries.rq04Evidence: RQ-04: the Cloudflare Pages entry dynamically invokes safeHandleDashboardRequest for the active private dashboard surface.
entries.retirementCondition: Retire when the dashboard Pages Function entry is replaced by an approved equivalent boundary and its auth/runtime contract is covered.

entries.rq04Evidence: RQ-04: the Cloudflare Pages entry has a private unavailable fallback that prevents a raw Worker 1101 response when the dashboard boundary fails.
entries.retirementCondition: Retire when the Pages entry has an approved failure boundary with the same private unavailable and observability guarantees.

entries.rq04Evidence: RQ-04: both active Astro page entry points render the graph-backed public route through PublicContentPage.
entries.retirementCondition: Retire when all graph-backed public entry points use an approved replacement renderer and the bilingual SEO/content contract is preserved.

entries.rq04Evidence: RQ-04: the workspace retains packages/dashboard-ui as an intentionally empty compatibility surface with only its TypeScript boundary.
entries.retirementCondition: Retire when the package gains a first shared dashboard UI module or is removed from the workspace through an approved architecture change.
